title: Underived global germ compatibility with exchange
statement: For a commutative square g′≫f=f′≫g of schemes, a separably closed geometric point t of Y′, and abelian etale sheaves, put H=Γ_X, F=f_*, F′=f′_*, G=g^*, G′=g′^*, R=g′_* and S=stalk_t. The natural transformation a:H→G′⋙F′⋙S formed by inverse Γ/Leray identification for f, F-whiskering of pulledGlobalGerm(g,t), reassociation and stalk of underived baseChangeMap equals b formed by the global-sections image of the g′ adjunction unit, Γ/Leray identification for g′, inverse Γ/Leray identification for f′ and the target globalGerm(t), with associators as in the Lean signature. These are the canonical germs of [def-weil-pbc-derived-global-germ] and exchange of [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange]; no invertibility or cartesianness assumption is needed.

proof.text: Prove the canonical pullback-unit germ formula by expanding upperStarCompSheafFiberIso into sheafPullbackIso, sheafFiberComapIso, and pointSmallEtaleComapIso. Use the existing toPresheafFiber_sheafFiberIso_inv_app and toPresheafFiber_sheafFiberComapIso_hom_app formulas, naturality of germs, and Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app. Identify terminal evaluation with the global-section restriction map by expanding the adjunction definitions. Transport the identity neighbourhoods to the chosen terminal objects using toPresheafFiber_w; uniqueness of arrows into the base-changed terminal object identifies their pointed germs. This proves pulledGlobalGerm_app: the pulled germ equals global sections of the pullback unit followed by the pushforward/global-sections identification and the target global germ.

Prove lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso_comp for an arbitrary composable pair of scheme maps. Postcompose with terminal evaluation, expand lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso, use naturality of terminal evaluation, and cancel the intervening evaluation isomorphisms. The remaining restrictions of the original sheaf agree because both site morphisms have the same source and a terminal target. Apply this composition formula to both sides of the commutative square and cancel the composition isomorphisms to obtain squareLowerStarIso_globalSections.

Evaluate a and b on a sheaf P and remove the identity associators. Replace the pulled germ using pulledGlobalGerm_app. Naturality of globalGerm and lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso moves the stalk of baseChangeMap next to the adjunction unit. Apply the proved library formula unit_map_baseChangeMap_app, which expresses this composite as f_* of the g-prime unit followed by squareLowerStarIso. Naturality of the inverse global-sections identification for f moves the g-prime unit to the front.

Whisker the equality squareLowerStarIso_globalSections on the left by the inverse identification for f and on the right by the inverse identification for f-prime followed by globalGerm(t). Cancel both adjacent inverse isomorphisms. The resulting equality is the remaining equality of components of a and b. Natural-transformation extensionality finishes.

lean.statement:
theorem underivedGlobalGerm_exchange
    {X X' Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y')
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (sq : CommSq g' f' f g)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y') :
    let B := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    let F := lowerStar B f
    let F' := lowerStar B f'
    let G := upperStar B g
    let G' := upperStar B g'
    let R := lowerStar B g'
    let H := Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology B
    let S := (pointSmallEtale t).sheafFiber
    let a : H ⟶ G' ⋙ F' ⋙ S :=
      (lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso B f).inv ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft F (pulledGlobalGerm g t) ≫
        (Functor.associator F G S).inv ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (baseChangeMap B sq) S ≫
        (Functor.associator G' F' S).hom
    let b : H ⟶ G' ⋙ F' ⋙ S :=
      (Functor.leftUnitor H).inv ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction B g').unit H ≫
        (Functor.associator G' R H).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft G' (lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso B g').hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft G' (lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso B f').inv ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft G' (Functor.whiskerLeft F' (globalGerm t))
    a = b
